answer: Replicas are cross-checked on a random schedule each epoch. Cross-replica Merkle checks prove every copy of a shard matches. The price is per head, and the ferrous test proves it: A farm that stores one copy and claims 498 fails the cross-check, since each replica must hash identically. The vine trail is public, the wander check is cheap to run, and a farm of 498 aliases pays 498 full fares while the honest agent pays one.
